summary: Verified GitHub webhook deliveries refresh the matching repository and ref observers, and webhook-covered repositories poll GraphQL only as a slow backstop

replay.detail: A daemon with [github].webhook_listen and webhook_secret_file serves POST /fractal/github-webhook on loopback, verifies X-Hub-Signature-256 against the per-request secret file, and writes observer.refresh-requested claims whose attempt starts with github-webhook: for matching active observers, once per delivery. Without those keys nothing runs. The polling member coalesces webhook refreshes: a poll still takes the oldest pending refresh, but one taken for a webhook refresh answers, right before its reads, the newest pending webhook refresh from the same member, which also answers the earlier ones from that member; declared refreshes answer only themselves. A github.repository observer with such a webhook refresh claim accepted within 30 minutes waits the 15-minute settled interval between GraphQL reads instead of 5 minutes, and a quiet standing poll uses the 10-minute ceiling at once; uncovered observers keep their cadence and refresh polls still bypass the floor.

schema.detail: observer.refresh-requested keeps its fields; a webhook refresh is marked only by the github-webhook: prefix of its required attempt string. No kind, table, projection, registry digest or numeric schema version changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule changes; observer.refresh-requested keeps its retention class.

compatibility.detail: Webhook refresh claims are ordinary observer.refresh-requested claims that every reader accepts. An N-1 member that polls a covered observer applies them as refreshes, one poll per delivery oldest first since it does not coalesce, and keeps its own cadence between them, since it does not read the attempt prefix as coverage. Declared refreshes are unchanged in both directions.

downtime.detail: No migration, rebuild or restart sequence.

manual.detail: To enable, configure [github].webhook_listen (loopback) and webhook_secret_file (absolute, owner-only) on the ingress member, the matching GitHub repository webhook (application/json, the same secret) and a proxy that forwards /fractal/github-webhook verbatim. Unconfigured daemons are unaffected.

recovery.detail: Remove the two keys to stop the receiver, and before rolling back a member that has them, since older configs reject unknown [github] keys; coverage lapses 30 minutes after the last webhook refresh and polling returns to its normal cadence. Rollback leaves webhook refresh claims in history; an older poller answers any it finds pending once each, like any other refresh.
